qualitative.note: Fails Gate 1 (Understandability, REJECT). Universal bank heavily reliant on Global Banking & Investor Solutions (GBIS), featuring large-scale structured equity derivatives and trading operations. Such opaque financial instruments and multitrillion-euro derivative notionals cannot be verified from the outside, violating the Munger transparency standard.
qualitative.evidence: Société Générale holds extensive Level 2 and Level 3 assets and derivative notionals exceeding €1.5T. It has suffered historical trading shocks including the €4.9B Kerviel rogue-trading scandal in 2008 and €500M+ structured product dividend markdowns during 2020. 10-year ROTE has averaged 6-8%, chronically below its cost of capital.
